text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, do you have any plans for our next
day off?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll be training, working out, and
building
some muscle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh... okay. Be careful not to get any
injuries then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait... Did you want to invite me out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? N-no... I just... I was thinking we
haven't
hung out in a while, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, why don't we go see a movie?
There's one
I've been wanting to see!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I'll do it on my next day off! Now
the
movie is all I can think about!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well that didn't take much convincing...
haha.
Okay, movie it is!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'll reserve our tickets. I'll make sure
we get
the best seats!
